nodes.name: Parcourir les pages categories et parser les offres

parameters.query:
WITH upserted_product AS (
  INSERT INTO products (brand, model, category, gender, age_group)
  VALUES ($2, $10, $3, $12, $13)
  ON CONFLICT (LOWER(brand), LOWER(model), category)
  DO UPDATE SET
    brand = EXCLUDED.brand,
    gender = CASE WHEN products.gender = 'non_determine' THEN EXCLUDED.gender ELSE products.gender END,
    age_group = CASE WHEN products.age_group = 'adulte' AND EXCLUDED.age_group = 'enfant' THEN 'enfant' ELSE products.age_group END
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO deals (title, brand, category, image_url, original_price, discounted_price, discount_percentage, merchant_id, affiliate_url, status, is_active, product_id, color)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, 'active', true, (SELECT id FROM upserted_product), $11)
ON CONFLICT (merchant_id, affiliate_url)
DO UPDATE SET
  title = EXCLUDED.title,
  brand = EXCLUDED.brand,
  category = EXCLUDED.category,
  image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url,
  original_price = EXCLUDED.original_price,
  discounted_price = EXCLUDED.discounted_price,
  discount_percentage = EXCLUDED.discount_percentage,
  product_id = EXCLUDED.product_id,
  color = EXCLUDED.color,
  status = 'active',
  is_active = true,
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING affiliate_url, merchant_id;

nodes.name: Regrouper les URLs vues aujourd hui

parameters.query:
UPDATE deals
SET status = 'expired', is_active = false, updated_at = NOW()
WHERE merchant_id = $1
  AND status = 'active'
  AND NOT (affiliate_url = ANY($2::text[]))
RETURNING id, title, affiliate_url;
